description: This file provides documentation for the HDMI Input HAL interface, describing its architecture, capabilities, initialization, resource management, data flow, state machine, and platform customization. It serves as a comprehensive design/specification document rather than executable or source code.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Defines the static capabilities of an HDMI input port, including supported versions, VICs, HDCP protocols, and feature flags.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Defines platform-wide constraints and features like maximum concurrent active ports and FreeSync support.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Represents the lifecycle states of an HDMI input resource.

methods.name: getHDMIInputIds
methods.description: Discovers available HDMI input port IDs.

methods.name: getDefaultEDID
methods.description: Retrieves the default EDID data for a specific version.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an HDMI input port and returns a controller handle.

methods.name: setEDID
methods.description: Sets custom EDID data for an HDMI port.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts HDMI signal acquisition on a port.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes an HDMI input port, releasing resources.
